title: Secret peace plans for the conflict in Ukraine
text:
QUESTION

PE782.738v01-00
Question for written answer E-000021/2026
to the Council
Rule 144
Fabio De Masi (NI)
Subject:
Secret peace plans for the conflict in Ukraine
According to press reports, secret peace plans for the conflict in Ukraine were drawn up
before the 28-point plan1. The reports state that the German Government was already aware of
an ‘Istanbul Plan’ on 4 November 2025. German and European diplomacy’s response to this
has been cautious.
1.
Was the plan discussed at Council level?
2.
Were Member States aware of the plan?
Submitted: 6.1.2026

(English version)
Question for written answer E-000021/26
to the Council
Fabio De Masi (NI)
(6 January 2026)
Subject: Secret peace plans for the conflict in Ukraine
According to press reports, secret peace plans for the conflict in Ukraine were drawn up before the 28-point plan (1). The
reports state that the German Government was already aware of an ‘Istanbul Plan’ on 4 November 2025. German and European
diplomacy’s response to this has been cautious.
1.
Was the plan discussed at Council level?
2.
Were Member States aware of the plan?
Submitted: 6.1.2026
Reply
(30 March 2026)
It is not for the Council to comment on articles appearing in the press. As to Member States’ awareness of any plan, we would
invite the Honourable Member to address his queries to the Member States in question.
